Author: Bakey Dev.
Message:
feat(music): add Jellyfin/Emby MediaBrowser source family

JellyfinSource implements the MediaBrowser API behind jellyfin (Authorization: MediaBrowser Token header) and emby (?api_key) presets: ping, search, random, favourites, star, library paging/album songs and stream/resolve to 16 kHz mono PCM with a preset-scoped cache. Credentials are url + write-only api_key; the adapter discovers the user id. Presets grow from five to seven. Verified offline with MockTransport (17 tests) and live against Jellyfin 12.3.0 and Emby 4.10.2 on the NAS: search/random/favourites/star/stream all pass. Tests that used jellyfin as an unimplemented sentinel now use plex.

feat(tts): xfyun as primary, and adopt the old project's parameters wholesale

9哥: don't reinvent the wheel - read what xiaoai-voice-entry already runs and use it.

- providers/xfyun_tts: 讯飞 v2 websocket TTS, HMAC-signed URL, base64 PCM frames streamed as
  they arrive, no decoder. Voice x4_lingxiaowan_boy (the speaker's current voice)
- providers/params: temperature, max_tokens and 'thinking: disabled' on the LLM provider;
  chat_payload() split out so the latency knobs are testable
- persona: the old project's 小瑞 text instead of my invented prompt
- scripts/measure_turn_pipeline: load ~/.hermes/.env, so a harness does not depend on the
  caller's shell

20 rounds, old project's parameters: first response p50 3563 ms (was 8713 with SiliconFlow
TTS), max 4197 (was 23541), ASR 463, first token 1065, 20/20 replies. 136 tests
